reference.latest_topic: 如果按照这个新思路主张：标签锚定的竞争类别验证，我该怎么准备我的实验计划？
reference.authority: user-selected research design, not proof of correctness or novelty
reference.source: User-referenced discussion and latest experimental plan, adopted on 2026-10-20

partition.identity: image path stem; every view/crop of an image stays together
partition.method: sort SHA256(seed|image_id); first round(N*0.1) images are D_rel
partition.validation_labels_usage: evaluation only; never fit, tune, construct prototypes, or choose feature definition
partition.class_coverage_failure: report and stop; do not cherry-pick another split

teacher.feature_layer: model.decoder.classifier input, 256 channels, before final 1x1 convolution
teacher.initialization: same permitted pretrained weights as existing VOC MC teacher; not a full-label SSL checkpoint
teacher.gradient_accumulation: allowed only if logical batch and BN semantics are recorded; do not silently substitute
teacher.bn_verifier_forward: eval, no gradient, restore previous train/eval state

prototypes.frozen_estimator: normalize equal-image mean of within-image class means of normalized sampled features
prototypes.feature_sampling: bilinear at original pixel centers, align_corners=True; normalize after sampling
prototypes.online_update: present classes only, detached D_sup features; no D_rel or D_U labels
prototypes.missing_class_policy: report support and invalidate formal comparison; never construct missing classes from hidden labels

scores.signed: development-only fallback; new protocol revision before confirmation if chosen
scores.fusion_temperature_selection: D_rel image CV only; selected once using fusion comparator, shared by all methods and conditional probes
scores.permutation_scope: each pixel, residual entries only; preserve original a, logits, similarities, MC/entropy/margin/RCV; hash-keyed pixel identity

verifier.architecture: padded input -> Linear(16) -> ReLU -> Linear(1) -> sigmoid; no BatchNorm or Dropout
verifier.loss: inverse-sampling-weighted unbalanced BCE, no artificial class balancing
verifier.preprocessing: weighted mean/std fitted only inside each training fold; constant std set to 1
verifier.selection: 3-fold image GroupKFold on D_rel, minimum weighted BCE; refit all D_rel; no early stopping on diagnostic validation
verifier.small_comparisons: MC-only has second input zero; every h(m,score) has two inputs
verifier.online_refresh: candidate: first warmup at 10%; then every 100 backbone steps refresh 4 cyclic D_rel images and 32 head updates; must freeze before G3-G7 start

statistics.primary_metric: error average precision, not trapezoidal PR area
primary_contrasts: h(mc,e) minus mean AP of separately refitted h(mc,e_permuted)
statistics.uniform_control: mandatory descriptive and paired interval; failure to beat uniform weakens mechanism attribution
statistics.interpretation: conditional on fixed teacher/prototypes/fitted verifier; stages and pixels are correlated; no seed-population guarantee

gates.P0: no leakage, all source hashes match, every prototype class has image support, implementation invariants pass
gates.P1: all four primary late-conflict contrast lower bounds >0 at familywise interval; positive point direction in at least 2/3 fixed stages; no clear all-pixel degradation; uniform control and support limits reported; then seed43 confirmation before broad training
gates.failed_P1: stop end-to-end expansion; record negative/inconclusive result, no automatic signed-score switch
gates.P2: new weights beat MC-only head and strongest prototype/fusion comparator in trained mIoU before adding seeds/generalization
gates.decisions_are: project resource rules, not conference acceptance criteria

end_to_end.schedule: 8 groups seed42, then 5 retained groups plus2 seeds =18 runs, excluding preparation teachers and mass/source ablations
end_to_end.mass_control: fixed reference rho from MC-only-head development training; compare matched total loss mass as separate ablation
end_to_end.checkpoint_selection: final fixed optimizer step as primary; best validation descriptive only

robustness.prototype_origin: same D_sup images/features, GT assignment versus predicted assignment
robustness.batch_regrouping: freeze model, prototype and head in eval; compare identical pixel identities across regrouped batches
robustness.cost: complete step time, peak memory and GPU hours incl. prototype/head refresh; microbenchmarks are separate

execution.resource_policy: inspect current allocation; never assume earlier free GPUs remain available
execution.resume_namespace: new study path; never overwrite original RCV artifacts
execution.status_as_of_design: server proxy DNS unresolved; formal experiments not started
